guia_conteudo.termos_texto:
By using Injectables Control, the user declares to be fully aware that:

1. The user assumes TOTAL and exclusive responsibility for the doses, mixtures (Mix), vial balances, and protocols generated.
2. CodeVibe Studio is NOT responsible for filling errors or miscalculations generated by incorrect data.
3. The "Lab Panel", "Clinical Progress" (alerts, color-coded tables, and charts), and "Cycle Simulator" are informational and mathematical estimates. They DO NOT constitute medical diagnosis, prescription, or advice.
4. Privacy: Your health records are stored privately with individual access isolation and are never sold or shared with third parties. You can edit or delete your records at any time.
5. The user exempts the creators from any clinical complication arising from the use of this organizational tool.
guia_conteudo.aviso_texto:
This application is exclusively a logistical and mathematical support tool. IT DOES NOT REPLACE MEDICAL ADVICE.

• The app does not prescribe or recommend treatments.
• If any marker appears out of range in Clinical Progress, bring the report to your doctor for evaluation.
• In case of extreme pain, fever, intense redness, swelling, shortness of breath, or any discomfort after an injection, SEEK AN EMERGENCY ROOM IMMEDIATELY or contact your doctor.
• Never start, titrate, or change dosages without the knowledge and authorization of your healthcare professional.
guia_conteudo.higiene_texto:
Lack of hygiene can cause serious infections and abscesses. Strictly follow:

• Wash hands with soap and water before touching materials.
• Clean the vial rubber with cotton and 70% Alcohol.
• Cleanse the skin with 70% Alcohol and let it air dry before puncturing.
• Use ONLY sterile, single-use (disposable) syringes and needles.
• Dispose of sharps in a suitable rigid container.
guia_conteudo.como_usar_texto:
• Home (Clinical Summary): Dynamic priority highlights your Next and Last Injection at the top, moving exam alerts up only when action is needed.

• Medication Database & Smart Schedule: Register your vials, rotation sites, and generate cycles by Full Vial, Weeks, Months, or Injections. When generating a new cycle, the app automatically deducts already applied volume, letting you continue the current vial (ideal for dose titration) or start a new vial.

• Clinical Progress: Log blood tests and bioimpedance/body measurements. Track out-of-range alerts, color-coded comparison tables, trend charts with reference bands, and share clean reports via email or copy for your doctor.

• Calculators & Cycle Simulator: Use the Reconstitution Assistant, Virtual Syringe, and Pharmacokinetic Simulator to visualize theoretical release curves.

• Safe Mix: Group compatible compounds in the same syringe with automatic volume summation.
guia_conteudo.cerebro_texto:
The app features a predictive safety engine:

• Biometric Profile: Cross-references biological sex, age, weight, and active protocol to suggest relevant exams for medical discussion, with direct email or copy options.

• Repeat Control: Once you confirm a collection, the history saves completed exams and automatically hides those still within their validity window.

• Pre-Exam Protocol: Before a scheduled collection, the system unlocks a Clinical Checklist (Fasting, Training Pause/CPK, Pelvic Rest, etc.) to avoid false positives.

• Biomarker Window: The first ideal window is suggested 45 days after starting a protocol, with follow-ups every 90 days.
guia_conteudo.notificacoes_texto:
To ensure maximum performance and save battery, our engine adopts a silent architecture:

• Anti-Spam Queue: Recent devices limit alarms per app. Therefore, the app automatically schedules the next 60 injections and refreshes the queue as you mark doses completed.

• Android Tip: To prevent OS delays or blocks, keep Battery set to "Unrestricted" and "Alarms & reminders" allowed in Settings → Apps → Injectables Control.
guia_conteudo.seringas_subtitulo: Understand the proper material for each application:
guia_conteudo.seringas_texto2:
• Subcutaneous (SC - Fat): Short and thin needles, e.g., 13x0.45mm or 13x0.3mm (brown/gray). Applied at a 90° or 45° angle depending on adipose tissue.
• Intramuscular (IM - Muscle): Long needles to reach the muscle, e.g., 25x0.7mm or 30x0.7mm (black/blue) and for larger volumes 25x0.8mm (green). Apply at a 90° angle.
guia_conteudo.seringas_texto4:
• Insulin Syringes (100 IU = 1 mL): Detailed scale. 10 IU equals 0.1 mL. Ideal for highly precise subcutaneous microdoses.
• 3 mL or 5 mL Syringes: Used for intramuscular applications requiring a larger volume of diluent or oil.
guia_conteudo.mapas_alerta_texto:
✅ The Ventrogluteal is now considered the gold standard and safest site for intramuscular injections, being completely free of large vessels and nerves.

❌ The old "Dorsogluteal" (upper outer quadrant) is being abandoned in current clinical practice. It poses a high risk of sciatic nerve injury and has more risks than benefits.

exames.checklist_subtitulo: Confirm the rules below to avoid false positives in your hormonal results.
exames.item1_desc: Mandatory for Basal Insulin and Glycemia. Max 14h. Drink plenty of water, it's allowed!
exames.item2_desc: Suspend weightlifting. Micro-lesions falsely elevate CPK, Creatinine, and AST.
exames.item3_desc: No ejaculation (avoids false Prolactin and PSA peaks). Do not ride motorcycles or bicycles.
exames.item4_desc: Zero alcohol to avoid acute peaks in GGT, Triglycerides, and systemic inflammation.
exames.item5_desc: Strict collection between 07h and 09h AM to catch Testosterone, TSH, and Prolactin at their basal peak.
exames.item6_desc: Do not pause or delay injections in the app. The exam must reflect real hormonal kinetics.
